evidence.description: Direct access to a global singleton service via .shared

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the 'EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager.shared' singleton instance to dispatch authentication state changes, creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or substitute.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Unstructured Task created in a property observer capturing self without cancellation

candidates.explanation: The 'userProfile' property is modified within a 'didSet' block that launches an unstructured 'Task'. This task captures 'self' (the actor) strongly and performs work that could outlive the operation, without any visible cancellation or lifecycle management.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management

evidence.description: Unstructured Task in initializer with no lifecycle management

candidates.explanation: The 'retrieveStoredCredentials' method is called within an unstructured 'Task' inside the initializer. This task can outlive the initialization process and has no visible mechanism to manage its lifetime or handle cancellation.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management
